test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends M, N, O, P and Q sit around a circular table facing away from the centre. O is sitting to the immediate left of P who sits third to the right of Q. M does not sit adjacent to P. Who sits to the immediate right of P?
solution: **Given : ** • Five friends - M, N, O, P and Q • All of them are sitting around a circular table. • All of them are facing away from the centre. **Explanation : ** 1) O is sitting to the immediate left of P who sits third to the right of Q.
